data.name: Ekasha
data.long_meaning: Ekasha is a Sanskrit word that means unique or one. It is derived from the root word 'eka' which means one. This name is often given to a child who is believed to be unique or special in some way.

in_sanskrit.name: एकाशा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ekam Asi, meaning 'I am One', is a famous mantra in Hinduism. Ekasha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ekam' which means 'One'. The suffix '-asha' denotes the state or condition of being. So, Ekasha means 'The state or condition of being One' or 'The state of being Alone' or 'The Solitary State'.

in_hindi.name: एकाशा
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ek meaning 'One' and Asha meaning 'hope' or 'wish'. So, Ekasha can be interpreted as 'The One who gives Hope' or 'The One who fulfills Wishes'. It can also mean 'The Solitary One'.
